title: 情報工学基礎演習
subtitle: Computer Programming Practice
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic management and operational skills for computer systems. (2) Acquire various C/Python programming skills on Linux command line. (3) Acquire Linux environment construction and operation technology.
advice: This is a basic C/Python programming course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Installing virtual machines and Linux 2. Linux command exercises 3. Programming with the basic data types and array 4. Standard input/output stream 5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls 6. Recursive function call 7. Programming with the structure and pointer 8. String processing 9. File input/output processing 10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks: ISBN-13:978-4815611682, ISBN-13:978-4815624316 Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course requires the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Programming 1” and “Programming 2” have been acquired. 2. Knowledge of basic logical operation. 3. Basic computer programming skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to manage programming, debugging, and execution.
Be able to create a program with appropriate combinations of functions, pointers, structures, etc.
Be able to verify that the program is executing correctly.

lessons.content: Basic Linux Operations 1 Terminal and Shell Basic commands (cat, ls, cd, pwd, mkdir, rm, etc .) Manual commands (man) How to use the editor How to call various processing systems (python, java, rust, c, c++)
Basic Linux Operations 2 Commands for files and directories Standard input, standard output, and standard er ror output Redirects and pipes Process management commands
Python Exercise 1 How to use the interpreter Lists, tuples, dictionaries, and sets Print and input Control structures if-else, for, while Function definitions, def and return
Quiz How to make C programs (preprocessor, compiler, assembler, linker, library)

C Language Basics 1 Assembly language has no data types Data types, arrays, terminal I/O Data types (char, int, float, double, size_t, in t8_t uint8_t, int32_t, uint32_t) and arrays Input/output using printf(), scanf(), getchar(), putchar() Address operators Sizeof operator Character codes

C Language Basics 2 Operators and Control Syntax, Constant Macros Ternary operators, sizeof() if, while, for, do-while, switch-case, continue, break Define Sleep sleep(), usleep() Numerical calculations (moving averages, integra ls...) State machine Random numbers, seeds
C Language Basics 3 User function definition and invocation, scope, stack area, commonly used standard functions Static modifiers Atoi, atof, strlen, fgets Recursive calls
C Language Applications 1 Pointers, dynamic allocation of memory, command line arguments malloc(), free()

C Language Applications 3 File operations (stream I/O), reading and writin g text and binary files -- . FILE*, stdin, stdout fopen, fclose, fread, fwrite, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fpr intf, fprintf
C Language Applications 4 Bitwise Operators (for “Embedded Systems”)
